reason: Kasser 2016 prints Sachbilanz tables for the gypsum board life cycle EXCEPT production: packaging (Tab. 11), transport DE->CH (Tab. 13), regional store (Tab. 16) and disposal (Tab. 19). The production inventory is withheld: 'Die Sachbilanzdaten der Gipsplatten-Produktion sind im vertraulichen Anhang Z zu ...' (p.144). Tab. 6-10 give the precursors (anhydrite, alpha/beta hemihydrate) but not the board.
